changes.text: Hides itself on keyboard-less devices: under `@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` (phones, tablets) the chip is now `display: none`. It is a capability query, not a width, so a narrow desktop window keeps its hints; plain-HTML `<kbd class="ss-kbd">` markup gets the new default too.

`hideOnMobile` prop (default `true`). Pass `hideOnMobile={false}` where the chip is the content rather than a hint; it renders `data-hide-on-mobile="false"` on the root, which is also the plain-HTML opt-out.

New component: a display-only key-cap chip for shortcut hints. `keys` takes a combo in the shortcut grammar (`'mod+k'`, `'?, mod+/'`) and renders nested `<kbd>` key caps per platform (`format="glyph"` by default, `format="label"` for always-words), with `platform` and `size` props, a full-word `aria-label` on glyph roots, and raw content (`<Kbd>F12</Kbd>`) for keys the grammar cannot express.
